root_cause: The v1-v3 matrix enumerated open dicts to sweep and asserted other sections 'closed'. The codebase has several open dicts (NodeSpec.params, StageSpec.params, SinkConfig.params), and the enumeration is fragile: each round a skeptic found another open dict the matrix had mis-asserted closed.

changed_approach.decision: Replace section enumeration with a single full-document recursive positional sweep. Do not list sections to sweep or assert any section closed.
changed_approach.walker: One recursive walk over the complete raw parsed document object in PipelineDocument.from_obj (the single parse entry shared by load_document and all public parse paths). The walker collects every occurrence of the key "$captured_artifact" with its position.
changed_approach.positional_legality: An occurrence is legal only when the dict carrying the "$captured_artifact" key is (a) the exact complete value (sole key) of a pipeline.<node>.inputs.<port> or foreach.pipeline.<template>.inputs.<port> entry, AND (b) the document has an execution_backtest block. Every other occurrence — in params, tracking.sinks[].params, stages, outputs, nested lists/maps, a $prev default, artifact, or any depth — refuses.
changed_approach.shape_validation: A single helper _validate_captured_descriptor(inner) enforces the exact six-key shape (root_ref/snapshot_version/document_sha256/node/output/purpose, all non-empty strings, document_sha256 exact lowercase 64-hex non-placeholder non-self). NodeSpec recognizes a legal input descriptor by this helper; the walker shape-checks every other occurrence for a correct diagnostic.
changed_approach.single_owner: One predicate _contains_captured_ref(obj) (dict key "$captured_artifact", recursing dict+list+tuple) is the sole detection primitive; the walker is built on it. No second spelling check exists.
changed_approach.no_enumeration: The matrix no longer asserts any section is closed or enumerates open dicts; the full-document walk makes the design robust to any present or future open dict.

required_successor_tests: positive: a legal descriptor as a complete node input in an execution document parses
negative: descriptor in NodeSpec.params, StageSpec.params, tracking.sinks[].params, foreach template inputs/params, outputs, artifact, $prev default, and nested in a list/map — each refuses
compatibility: ordinary documents (with and without foreach/stages/tracking) with no descriptor remain byte/hash-identical
